cipher.idea: A deterministic word-level transformation that reverses the order of letters within each word independently. The positions of words, whitespace, punctuation, digits, and other non-letter characters remain unchanged.

Preserve the original characters and their case; only their order within the word changes. All non-letter characters, including spaces, punctuation, digits, and symbols, remain unchanged and stay in their original positions relative to word boundaries. For example, Hello becomes olleH, world becomes dlrow, and This becomes sihT.
cipher.decrypt_rules: Apply the same transformation as encryption. Process each contiguous sequence of alphabetic characters as a word and reverse the order of its letters. Since reversing a sequence twice restores the original sequence, this operation is self-inverse. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
